name: i3 Keypad
description: The i3 Keypad: a dimmer with four buttons and LEDs, button 1 at the top. Most settings are per button.

enumerations.name: manualChangeDirection
enumerations.description: Which way a manual change moves the level.

enumerations.name: triggerLevel
enumerations.description: Which level a triggered group sets the local load to. The values are the reverse of the KeypadLinc's.

values.name: givenLevel
values.description: The level in D3.

values.name: localOnLevel
values.description: The local load's own on-level.

enumerations.name: triggerRampRate
enumerations.description: How fast a triggered group changes the local load.

values.name: localRampRate
values.description: At the local load's ramp rate.

values.name: instant
values.description: Instantly.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking from the SET button is locked out.

operatingFlags.name: resumeDim
operatingFlags.description: Brightening or dimming the load by holding its button also sets its on-level. Clear by default.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't transmit over RF, which can help several switches in one box.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: After a press, the LED flashes green if every cleanup succeeded and red if one failed.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: After a press, the device broadcasts a cleanup report (cmd1 0x06) with the number of cleanups that failed. Set by default.

operatingFlags.name: nightMode
operatingFlags.description: It's night: the device uses its night on-level limit, ramp rate and LED brightness. Night mode on (cmd1 0x3B) sets it and night mode off (cmd1 0x3C) clears it, as direct or group commands.

operatingFlags.name: detachedLoad
operatingFlags.description: No button controls the load; only other devices do.

operatingFlags.name: dimmerMode
operatingFlags.description: The device dims the load with its triac. Clear, it only switches the load with its relay. Set by default.

operatingFlags.name: pushHopsToRadio
operatingFlags.description: The device repeats every powerline message over RF, for an RF-only device that only one powerline device can reach. Clear, it repeats a message over RF only if it heard it over RF or sent it.

operatingFlags.name: relayAtFullOn
operatingFlags.description: At full on, the device closes its relay to shed heat, even as a dimmer.

operatingFlags.name: nightLed
operatingFlags.description: The LEDs use their night colors for on and off.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error. It rolls over from 255 to 0.

readings.name: failureCount
readings.description: The number of times the device heard what looked like the start of a message but wasn't one. It rolls over from 255 to 0.

readings.name: triggerMask
readings.description: The groups that send a trigger command (cmd1 0x30) when pressed, one bit per group with group 1 in bit 0.

flagCommands.name: lightingDirectorController
flagCommands.description: Sets up the keypad as a Lighting Director scene controller in one step: button 4 controls the scene instead of the load, buttons 2 and 3 send on at ramp rate and a Lighting Director index, and the masks, ramp rates, on-levels and LED profiles to match.

values.name: onMask
values.description: The other LEDs that turn on when this button is pressed, for buttons that control the same load.

values.name: offMask
values.description: The other LEDs that turn off when this button is pressed.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds. 0x1F by default.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full). 0xFF by default.

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The brightness of the LEDs, on and off, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest). Not per button. 0x3F by default.

values.name: nonToggleMask
values.description: The buttons that send only one command instead of toggling between on and off. Not per button.

values.name: ledMask
values.description: The LEDs that are on, apart from the load's. A toggling button's next command follows its LED. Not per button.

values.name: nonToggleOffMask
values.description: Of the non-toggling buttons, the ones that send off instead of on. Not per button.

verification.note: No document states which value sends off; this reading follows the property's name. The KeypadLinc's byte 13 is named for the opposite.

values.name: groupMask
values.description: With the LED off mask, the buttons that act as radio buttons, with only one LED on at a time.

writes.name: offMask
writes.description: Sets the LED off mask and LED group mask.

writes.name: ledMask
writes.description: Sets the LEDs that are on.

writes.name: loadCalibration
writes.description: Sets the maximum, minimum and starting on-levels, which readLoadSettings reads.

writes.name: nightSettings
writes.description: Sets the night on-level limit, LED brightness and ramp rate, which readLoadSettings reads.

verification.note: The table puts the night on-level limit in D3, the LED brightness in D4 and the ramp rate in D5, in the order of the Get reply; the example lists them the other way round.

writes.name: triggerMask
writes.description: Sets which groups send a trigger command (cmd1 0x30) when pressed, one bit per group with group 1 in bit 0, so that two devices can control one scene without links in every device. Read it with operating flags query 0x08.

writes.name: loadNumber
writes.description: Sets which button, 1 through 4, controls the load, which readLoadSettings reads. To have none of them control it, set detachedLoad.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 at the saved ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at the saved ramp rate.

standardCommands.name: lightOffFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off instantly.

standardCommands.name: brightenOneStep
standardCommands.description: Brightens the load one step.

standardCommands.name: dimOneStep
standardCommands.description: Dims the load one step.

standardCommands.name: startManualChange
standardCommands.description: Starts brightening or dimming the load until a stop manual change command.

parameter.name: direction
parameter.description: Which way to change the level.

standardCommands.name: stopManualChange
standardCommands.description: Stops a manual change.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

standardCommands.name: readLeds
standardCommands.description: Reads which button LEDs are on. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

reply.name: leds
reply.description: The LEDs that are on, with button 1 in bit 0.

standardCommands.name: readTargetLevel
standardCommands.description: Reads the level the load is moving to.

reply.name: targetLevel
reply.description: The level the load is moving to, or its level if it isn't moving.

standardCommands.name: readRadioFirmware
standardCommands.description: Reads the version of the RF firmware, which is separate from the device's firmware version.

standardCommands.name: readLightingDirectorIndex
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level as an index into the device's Lighting Director profile, which must be written first.

standardCommands.name: readLevelPercent
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level as a percentage of the way from the minimum on-level to the maximum.

standardCommands.name: requestDatabaseChecksum
standardCommands.description: Has the device broadcast its ALL-Link database checksum (cmd1 0x3A) after the acknowledgment, with a 3-byte Fletcher checksum in the To address. It leaves out the hop counts, the fast fail bits and inactive records, so it changes only when the links do.

standardCommands.name: instantChange
standardCommands.description: Sets the load to the level in cmd2 instantly, ignoring the ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once.

standardCommands.name: readSuccessReport
standardCommands.description: Reads how many cleanups failed after the last press.

standardCommands.name: groupOn
standardCommands.description: Acts as if a button had been pressed on: the device broadcasts and cleans up the group's On command.

standardCommands.name: groupOff
standardCommands.description: Acts as if a button had been pressed off: the device broadcasts and cleans up the group's Off command.

standardCommands.name: onAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to a level at a ramp rate, both given in cmd2.

parameter.name: levelAndRampRate
parameter.description: Bits 4 through 7 give the level divided by 16, and bits 0 through 3 the ramp rate minus 1, divided by 2.

standardCommands.name: offAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at a ramp rate given in cmd2.

parameter.name: rampRate
parameter.description: The ramp rate minus 1, divided by 2.

verification.note: The example sends 0x0F for ramp rate 0x0F; the formula gives 0x07.

standardCommands.name: changeLevel
standardCommands.description: Brightens or dims the load by an amount, stopping at off or full.

parameter.name: amount
parameter.description: 0x00 through 0x7F brighten by that much; 0x80 through 0xFF dim by bits 0 through 6, so 0x89 dims by 9.

verification.note: The text calls the value a signed 8-bit integer; its ranges and its example, which adds -9 with 0x89, make bit 7 the sign and bits 0 through 6 the amount, as used here.

standardCommands.name: onPercent
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to a percentage of the way from the minimum on-level to the maximum.

standardCommands.name: nightModeOn
standardCommands.description: Sets night mode. It can also be sent as a group command, to set many devices at once.

standardCommands.name: nightModeOff
standardCommands.description: Clears night mode. It can also be sent as a group command.

verification.note: Its request table prints cmd1 0x3B; its heading and example give 0x3C.

extendedCommands.name: readLoadSettings
extendedCommands.description: Reads the load calibration and night settings, which the extended Set writes with selectors 0x0D and 0x12.

values.name: maxOnLevel
values.description: The highest level the load goes to. 0xF1 by default.

values.name: minOnLevel
values.description: The lowest level the load dims to before it turns off, which can stop flicker. 0x20 by default.

values.name: startOnLevel
values.description: The level the load starts at when it turns on from off, for loads that must reach some power before they dim lower. 0x00 by default.

values.name: nightMaxOnLevel
values.description: The highest level at night. 0x7F by default.

values.name: nightLedBrightness
values.description: The LED brightness at night. 0x1F by default.

values.name: nightRampRate
values.description: The ramp rate at night. 0x1B by default.

values.name: loadNumber
values.description: The button, 1 through 4, that controls the load. 0x01 by default.

extendedCommands.name: readProperties
extendedCommands.description: Reads most bit and byte properties at once.

values.name: flags00
values.description: The bits of the 0x00 operating flags reply.

values.name: flags05
values.description: The bits of the 0x05 operating flags reply.

values.name: flagsMisc
values.description: Other bits.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The on-level.

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The LED brightness.

values.name: maxOnLevel
values.description: The highest level the load goes to.

verification.note: The reply table names D8 the minimum on-level and D9 the maximum, but its example values, 0xF1 and 0x20, are the defaults of the maximum and minimum; the Get page holds the maximum first.

values.name: minOnLevel

verification.note: The reply table names D8 the minimum on-level and D9 the maximum, but its example values, 0xF1 and 0x20, are the defaults of the maximum and minimum; the Get page holds the maximum first.

values.name: startOnLevel
values.description: The level the load starts at from off.

values.name: nightMaxOnLevel
values.description: The highest level at night.

values.name: nightLedBrightness
values.description: The LED brightness at night.

values.name: nightRampRate

extendedCommands.name: writeProperties
extendedCommands.description: Sets the properties that readProperties reads, at once.

parameters.name: flags00
parameters.description: The bits of the 0x00 operating flags reply.

parameters.name: flags05

parameters.name: maxOnLevel

verification.note: The reply table names D8 the minimum on-level and D9 the maximum, but its example values, 0xF1 and 0x20, are the defaults of the maximum and minimum; the Get page holds the maximum first.

verification.note: The reply table names D8 the minimum on-level and D9 the maximum, but its example values, 0xF1 and 0x20, are the defaults of the maximum and minimum; the Get page holds the maximum first.

parameters.name: startOnLevel

extendedCommands.name: triggerGroup
extendedCommands.description: Acts as if group D1's button had been pressed: the device sets the local load and broadcasts and cleans up the group, with the command in D4 and D5. The device must be linked to the sender.

parameters.name: levelSource
parameters.description: Which level the local load goes to.

parameters.name: onLevel
parameters.description: The level the local load goes to when D2 is 0x00.

parameters.name: groupCommand1
parameters.description: The cmd1 to send to the group.

parameters.name: groupCommand2
parameters.description: The cmd2 to send to the group.

parameters.name: rampRate
parameters.description: How fast the local load changes.

extendedCommands.name: factoryReset
extendedCommands.description: Resets every property to its factory value, as holding the SET button while power returns does. The device checks that D1 and D2 are its category and subcategory.

verification.note: The command's heading gives cmd1 0x34, which is on at ramp rate; its table and its example, whose checksum only works for 0x36, give 0x36.

notes: Ramp rate 0x00 is 2 seconds, 0x01 8 minutes, 0x0A 2 minutes, 0x0D 47 seconds, 0x13 28 seconds, 0x18 8.5 seconds, 0x1B 2 seconds, 0x1C 0.5 second and 0x1F 0.1 second.

The device ignores or rejects any command its documents don't list, Product Data Request (cmd1 0x03) among them. Besides the commands here, they list the linking commands, Get Insteon Engine Version, ID Request and ALL-Link database reads, writes and modifies.

Its database layout gives records from 0x0FFF down to 0x0300, 416 of them; the database read reply gives addresses from 0x0FFF to 0x0407. Bit 0 of a record's flags is fast fail, bit 2 marks a Lighting Director record, bits 3 and 4 hold its hop count and bit 5 is always 1; the device may change some of these bits on its own.
The load settings reply (readLoadSettings) starts with the same bytes as the extended Get reply, so wait for one before asking for the other.
D14 of the extended Get reply is the group mask, not a checksum, and the Get request carries no checksum.
Bit 4 of operating flags query 0x05, set and cleared with cmd2 0x19 and 0x18, locks the buttons here; on the KeypadLinc it asks for checksums.
The extended Set also takes selector 0x11, LED flags, per group, which the documents don't describe.
